have recently changed to a new practice after being with Bridges (often unhappily) for about 9 years. Waiting times are the main issue. I found that the waiting times for routine appointments rarely seem to dip below 2- 4 weeks, and sometimes rise to 6 weeks or more. You can always 'ring on the day' for appointments but if you want pre-scheduled appointments then the wait times seem high.

Some of the GPs there are pleasant and approachable and sympathetic and some are robotic, hard, and sadly clearly stressed. You can of course refuse to see the GPs with the poor bedside manner and go for the nice ones, but that then pushes your waiting time ever higher.

I also had a bad experience trying to claim on my holiday insurance when I became ill - the doctor in question at this practice and the admin staff (as did the insurance company to be fair) made things tricky in not providing me with info I needed when I tried to claim. This led to a lot of stress and back and forth. This was the last straw, but the main reason I left were the waiting times.

I have also noticed that the surgery seems to be responding to the more recent reviews here and some of their responses are interesting...  to say the least.

Edit - I see the practice has now replied - wish they were as quick to offer pre-scheduled appointments as they are to reply on here! 😎 Ultimately, for me I don't think they have the balance right between pre-booked and 'ring on the day' (which employers often don't like) so I will try elsewhere in Gateshead. Hopefully this also frees up capacity at Bridges for another patient to use if Bridges are so stretched.

Also by 'routine' I mean 'pre-booked' or pre-scheduled - the problem with ringing on the day is that it means you may have an appointment at very short notice which employers understandably don't really like.

Further edit: There is no point doxxing myself on here or contacting the surgery as I have now left the practice! 😅 I fully sympathise with the pressure GPs are under but I've given Bridges plenty of time and plenty of chances so it's now right for me to try another practice in Gateshead.",null,[0,234]]]],[null,1632742468000000,1632742468000000,"4 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10627284065612921055/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUTJNbkJsV0V0bkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Without knowing who is posting this review, it is impossible to respond to, or look into, the specifics regarding the insurance matter.
